description: The Customer Returns page (kind=customer, default) or supplier returns (kind=supplier), newest first: status, the customer or supplier, the sales or purchase order it came from, warehouse, units on the return and units received back (customer) or shipped out (supplier), and whether a customer return has been credited. Filter by status, source order or search text. Call get_return for a return's lines, receipts and credit notes.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

search.description: Search text: return number or customer/supplier name.

sourceOrderId.description: Optional source order id (GUID): the sales order (customer returns) or purchase order (supplier returns) the returns came from.

status.description: Optional stored status, e.g. waitingApproval, issued, receiving, received, fulfilled (customer) or issued, shipping, shipped (supplier).

name: list_returns
title: List Returns
